description: This source file defines the _PROXY_MaxBudgetLimiter class, implementing a pre-call hook for rate-limiting requests based on user budget limits in a FastAPI application. It manages cache retrieval and enforces a maximum budget constraint, raising HTTP exceptions when limits are exceeded.
